## 4. Data Management and Entry Protocols

### 2024 vs 2025 Data Priority
- **Decision:** Brianna to focus on 2025 data entry rather than completing 2024 backlog
- Stuart continuing direct entry of 2024 data into NASIS
- 47 sites remaining from 2024 data
- 2025 descriptions are more complete and better suited for newer team members

### Site Numbering System
- 2025 sites starting fresh at numbering sequence 2025MNxxx001, 002, 003...
- Caution needed when entering data to ensure correct year assignment
- Survey123 auto-populates current year, requiring manual adjustment for 2024 data

### Data Entry Technical Notes (from Patty)
**Special character restrictions in NASIS field notes text box:**
- No dashes, carets (^), or ampersands (&)
- Write out "caret" instead of using ^ symbol
- Write "and" instead of & symbol
- Don't specify HCl type in effervescence descriptions
- Stick to basic effervescence terms (slight, strong, etc.)

### Concept Assignment
- Team members should assign soil concepts during field work
- Concept information to be recorded in pedon tracker spreadsheet
- Nora will print hard copy of concept list for field reference
